name: text-hover-effect
blurb: Rainbow gradient text reveals under the cursor as you hover, with initial stroke-dash animation.
description: SVG text component with a radial mask gradient that follows the cursor, revealing a rainbow fill underneath. Initial stroke-dasharray animation draws the outline before hover.
use_when: Large display headlines or hero text that should feel interactive and playful on desktop.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces, as the effect requires pointer tracking. Does not work well on mobile.
a11y: Text rendered as SVG; no alternative text content. Animation follows cursor only on hover, does not respond to prefers-reduced-motion.
